title: Nvidia Chip Curbs Just Got Tighter — Is Anthropic the Surprise Hidden Winner?
author: OutcomeRich987
selftext: [Whoa, the new U.S. chip restrictions targeting advanced computing access instead of just shipments might shake things up big time. ](https://www.moomoo.com/news/post/1004511735?global_content=%7B"promote_content":"11067213","promote_id":20795,"promote_type":43,"sub_promote_id":1%7D)Open-weight models are eating way more token share now, but closed models still grab most of the spending. If Chinese open model development slows a little, Anthropic could catch a break on pricing pressure and juice its margins way faster. Wild to see how these new rules flip the AI market playbook right now?

comments.author: Eastern-Apartment934
comments.body: Chip restrictions may slow compute access, but they won't stop open models from getting better.
